description: Residuals of the predicted CMB lensing template compared with Planck 2018, including guardband checks on Δχ² and residual amplitudes derived in Phase 21.

inputs.description: Planck 2018 CMB lensing bandpowers and covariance used in the residual and χ² computations.

source.note: Dataset mirrored in the full Echo Equation data bundle.

inputs.description: Phase 21 predicted CMB lensing curves for the Echo Equation model and ΛCDM baseline.

code_scripts.description: Computes lensing residuals, Δχ² values, and guardband metrics and generates the Figure 3 plot.

reproducibility.notes: Reproduces the residual plot and the guard metrics summarised in guard_metrics_summary.csv. Requires the full Echo Equation data bundle.
